findings.issue: The cw10b label writes a cardinality into prose ('exactly the two whose writers format the name inline') beside a check that pins those rows by prefix. A third inline-formatted row would make the sentence false while the check says what it checks. The task says no number written into prose; a word under ten is legal to the lint, so this is author-enforced, not a lint failure.
findings.resolution: Drop 'the two' from the label and name the pinned rows (journal pre-image, TDD reminder) only, as the comment above it already does.
